summary: This document defines a new IKEv2 Traffic Selector type, TS_SECLABEL, so peers can negotiate Mandatory Access Control security labels as part of the Security Policy Database. This is called Labeled IPsec. The label is carried as a variable-length opaque field.

eli5.summary: Some secure places put colored badges on everything, and only matching badges may mix. This lets two computers agree on those badges when they set up a private tunnel.
